findings.debt_id: M45-D7 (widened from two guards to three)
findings.what: Filed by widening M45-D7 rather than opening a new block, per the orchestrator's preference and because it is literally the same defect: a guard written in a repair round is red-capable for that round's literal target, and its resolution record then describes it as covering the class. The block's title moves from 'both PR #56 guards' to 'all three', its Spec gains clause (3) carrying R11's mutation verbatim (the perl retarget of all four pointers to M45-D4 leaves the case GREEN) plus the control that proves coverage rather than vacuity (renaming the heading to ### M45-D10 goes red), and its Acceptance gains the fix: resolve the id found at each pointer SITE instead of taking the heading from the case's own config. NOT fixed here — R11 is LOW and routed to debt, and the record-correction half was done instead.

Took the shorter diff the orchestrator preferred: tasks/TODO.md M45-D5's Acceptance is now count-free — 'one of the narrowings M45 withdrew' — so the known-wrong 'three' no longer has a fourth home. Also extended M45-D9's Acceptance to ENUMERATE every surface carrying the count (analysis.md's attempts table, D31, the M45 RESULT block, the case triage, and M45-D5 itself), so closing D9 by its own checklist cannot leave a wrong count behind, which was the substance of the finding. D5 stays on that list even though it is now count-free, so a future edit that re-introduces a number there is caught by the same checklist. No separate debt block: the count problem already has one, and a near-duplicate of M45-D9 would be the kind of bookkeeping this loop is trying to avoid.

required_record_correction.what: R8 moves from `fixed` to `partially_fixed` with a dated correction, the same treatment R10 forced on R1 a round earlier. It states what IS pinned (the target block must exist and carry 'request frame' / 'imperative' / 'Acceptance:', so deleting or gutting M45-D8 goes red) and what is NOT (the four pointers — the heading is hardcoded in config, and retargeting all four back to M45-D4 leaves the case green).
